title: AI3 Nexus
tagline: AI-powered trading with on-chain security designed to help users navigate the world of cryptocurrency trading with ease.
description:
Overview :
This project is an AI-powered crypto trading chatbot that seamlessly integrates with EigenLayer AVS and Coinbase’s Agent Kit, offering real-time insights into trending tokens, facilitating fund transfers, and ensuring on-chain transparency. The chatbot is designed to empower both novice and experienced crypto traders by providing AI-driven market research, social media sentiment analysis, and on-chain transaction tracking.

Key Components
1️⃣ On-Chain Conversational AI on EigenLayer AVS
We leverage EigenLayer’s Actively Validated Services (AVS) to ensure that all interactions, queries, and transactions within the chatbot are fully recorded on-chain, providing a transparent and verifiable record of user activity.

Key Features:
On-Chain Transaction Logging: Every interaction with the chatbot, including market insights, queries, and trade executions, is recorded on the blockchain, ensuring full transparency and auditability.
Trending Token Insights: Users can ask the chatbot about trending tokens, and it retrieves real-time data from on-chain analytics and trading platforms.
Direct TradingView Integration: Users can request price charts, key indicators, and technical analysis directly within the chat, streamlining the research process.
Smart Contract Execution: The chatbot can trigger smart contract-based trades, allowing users to execute predefined trading strategies with on-chain security.
2️⃣ AI-Driven Trading Assistant on Coinbase
By leveraging Coinbase’s Agent Kit, our chatbot integrates seamlessly with Coinbase Wallet, allowing users to manage their crypto holdings, analyze the market, and execute transactions through AI-driven automation.

Key Features:
Coinbase Wallet Integration: Users can connect their Coinbase Wallet directly to the chatbot, enabling them to check balances, transfer funds, and execute trades securely.
AI-Powered Research Agent: The chatbot includes a dedicated research agent that pulls the latest crypto news, trends, and market insights from multiple sources, providing real-time updates on token movements and regulatory changes.
Social Media Sentiment Analysis: A social media agent continuously monitors Twitter, Discord, and other platforms, detecting emerging trends and potential market movements based on community sentiment.
On-Chain Trading Execution: Users can initiate secure, on-chain transactions using Base Sepolia Testnet, ensuring fast and low-cost trade execution.
How It Works
1️⃣ User connects their Coinbase Wallet to the chatbot.
2️⃣ User asks about a trending token, and the chatbot retrieves real-time insights, including price action, trading volume, and social media sentiment.
3️⃣ User requests deeper analysis, and the chatbot fetches on-chain analytics, technical indicators, and historical trends via EigenLayer AVS.
4️⃣ If the user chooses to trade, the chatbot executes transactions securely on Base Sepolia, leveraging smart contracts for automation.
5️⃣ All interactions and trades are recorded on-chain, ensuring complete transparency and immutability.
how_its_made:
We leveraged AI Agent Kit to power the chatbot’s intelligence, enabling it to analyze real-time crypto market trends and facilitate seamless trading. To handle fund transfers and trading execution, we integrated Coinbase, ensuring secure and efficient transactions. The entire system is built on EigenLayer AVS, providing decentralized security and on-chain transparency, ensuring every transaction is verifiable and trustless.

A particularly hacky and notable part of our implementation was optimizing AI inference for real-time token trend analysis while maintaining low-latency fund transfers through EigenLayer’s AVS infrastructure. This approach enhances both performance and trust in the system.
